name: io.github.sriinnu/kosha-discovery
title: Kosha Model Discovery
description: Tells your agent which model to use and what it costs, across 45 providers and local runtimes.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key. Optional — without it, Anthropic models are read from the public models.dev / LiteLLM catalogs instead of the live API.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key. Optional — falls back to the public catalogs when absent.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google AI Studio / Gemini API key. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter key. Optional for discovery (unauthenticated requests are rate-limited), required to execute through OpenRouter.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TypeSafe System One (Jev) API key. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: KOSHA_CACHE_TTL_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: Override the discovery cache TTL. Defaults to 24 hours.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Every provider key is optional. With no credentials at all, kosha still answers from the public models.dev and LiteLLM catalogs plus a curated offline list, so the server is useful on a fresh machine. Full env var reference: docs/credentials.md.
